name: Cloudflare application foundation
description: Establish the Next.js web application, standalone Hono Worker API, shared types, environment validation, tenant context, observability, and local development commands.
steps: Invalid or missing environment fails safely
Requests carry trace IDs and structured errors

name: Authentication and tenant authorization
description: Implement Better Auth on Hono/D1 with magic links, optional Google and Microsoft OAuth, organization roles, speaker ownership checks, API keys, and strict tenant isolation.
steps: Google and Microsoft providers can be configured
API keys are scoped and revocable

name: Airtable domain repository
description: Model program business entities in Airtable behind typed repositories with stable application IDs, pagination, retries, rate-limit handling, and deterministic test doubles.
steps: Airtable record IDs never become public IDs
Repository tests use a deterministic fake

name: Event and CFP configuration
description: Allow organizers to configure event details, CFP dates, submission limits, tracks, tags, formats, levels, form fields, validation, welcome copy, and helpful links.
steps: Organizer can create and edit an event
Required and optional fields are configurable
Submission limits and dates are enforced

name: Five-step speaker submission
description: Deliver the evidence-matched Welcome, Account, Submission, Participant, and Review flow with rich text, drafts, searchable selects, co-speakers, secondary contacts, validation, and confirmation.
steps: Participants can be added and edited
Review can navigate back to edit

name: Speaker portal and tasks
description: Provide speaker home, submissions, profile, status, and task views; allow biography updates and post-acceptance task completion with private file uploads.
steps: Private uploads require authorized expiring access

name: Committee review and decisions
description: Create evaluation plans, assign submissions, collect rubric scores/comments, manage conflicts, support blind review, and record human-authoritative accept/waitlist/reject decisions.

name: Transactional email workflows
description: Send magic links, confirmations, decisions, reminders, and task notices through OpenSend using approved foreverbrowsing.com identities with templates, idempotency, retries, and auditing.
steps: Duplicate jobs do not duplicate mail

name: Conflict-safe agenda scheduling
description: Schedule accepted sessions into rooms and tracks with timezone-aware slots, speaker/resource conflict detection, concurrent mutation locks, draft versions, and explicit publication.
steps: Speaker and room overlaps are blocked
Draft changes do not leak publicly

name: Standards-based calendar delivery
description: Generate RFC 5545 REQUEST, UPDATE, and CANCEL messages for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Calendar, and generic iCal clients with stable UID, incrementing SEQUENCE, and explicit TZID.
steps: Schedule changes reuse UID and increment SEQUENCE

name: Public speaker and agenda embeds
description: Publish responsive, accessible, fast speaker gallery and itinerary/agenda surfaces using only explicitly published projection data.
steps: Public responses are cacheable and fast

name: Versioned public API and webhooks
description: Expose documented, tenant-scoped REST resources with cursor pagination, consistent errors, idempotent writes, OpenAPI, scoped API keys, and signed retrying webhooks.

name: Controlled Accelevents publication
description: Provide an outbound-only Accelevents adapter that previews diffs and requires explicit organizer confirmation before publishing selected program data.
steps: No outbound write occurs without confirmation

name: Audit, security, and privacy controls
description: Implement audit events, secure rich-text handling, CORS/CSRF protections, rate limiting, secret hygiene, private files, data minimization, and safe error responses.
steps: XSS and injection payloads are harmless
No secrets or stack traces leak
Rate limits protect public and auth routes

name: Cloudflare deployment
description: Provision and deploy Workers, D1, Durable Objects, R2, Queues, and the web surface with reproducible configuration and least-privilege credentials.
steps: Preview and production deployments are reproducible
Health and smoke checks pass after deploy

name: Accessibility and performance
description: Meet WCAG 2.1 AA on primary flows and deliver a fast evaluator experience with responsive layouts, optimized bundles, caching, and measured performance budgets.
steps: Core pages meet defined Web Vitals and API latency budgets

name: End-to-end release verification
description: Prove the evaluator walkthrough through automated tests, Ever, and codex-cua interaction checks before changing the Forge repository from private to public.
steps: Checks, unit, API, security, and E2E suites pass
codex-cua visual and interaction checks pass
Forge remains private until every gate passes
